mapper.select: select count(1) as visitCount, sum(case when c.satisfaction is not null and c.satisfaction <> '' then 1 else 0 end) as ratedCount, sum(case when c.satisfaction = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as verySatisfiedCount, sum(case when c.satisfaction = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as satisfiedCount, sum(case when c.satisfaction = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as normalCount, sum(case when c.satisfaction = '4' then 1 else 0 end) as unsatisfiedCount, sum(case when c.status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as pendingCount, sum(case when c.status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as completedCount, sum(case when c.status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as unreachableCount, round(avg(case when c.satisfaction is not null and c.satisfaction <> '' then (5 - cast(c.satisfaction as unsigned)) end), 2) as avgScore from ai_callback c where c.visit_time is not null and c.visit_time >= #{beginTime} and c.visit_time < #{endTime}

select date(c.visit_time) as statDate, sum(case when c.satisfaction = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as verySatisfied, sum(case when c.satisfaction = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as satisfied, sum(case when c.satisfaction = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as normal, sum(case when c.satisfaction = '4' then 1 else 0 end) as unsatisfied, count(1) as total from ai_callback c where c.visit_time is not null and c.visit_time >= #{beginTime} and c.visit_time < #{endTime} group by date(c.visit_time) order by statDate

select c.visit_by_id as userId, coalesce(nullif(c.visit_by, ''), concat('用户', c.visit_by_id)) as userName, count(1) as visitCount, sum(case when c.satisfaction in ('1','2') then 1 else 0 end) as satisfiedCount, sum(case when c.satisfaction = '4' then 1 else 0 end) as unsatisfiedCount, round(avg(case when c.satisfaction is not null and c.satisfaction <> '' then (5 - cast(c.satisfaction as unsigned)) end), 2) as avgScore from ai_callback c where c.visit_time is not null and c.visit_time >= #{beginTime} and c.visit_time < #{endTime} and c.visit_by is not null and c.visit_by <> '' group by c.visit_by_id, c.visit_by order by visitCount desc, unsatisfiedCount desc

select c.callback_id as callbackId, c.satisfaction as satisfaction, c.visit_opinion as opinion, c.visit_result as visitResult, c.caller_name as callerName from ai_callback c where c.visit_time >= #{beginTime} and c.visit_time < #{endTime} and c.satisfaction in ('3','4') and c.visit_opinion is not null and c.visit_opinion <> '' order by c.visit_time desc limit #{limit}

select count(1) as evalCount, round(avg(e.overall_rating), 2) as avgOverall, round(avg(e.professionalism_rating), 2) as avgProfessionalism, round(avg(e.responsiveness_rating), 2) as avgResponsiveness, round(avg(e.quality_rating), 2) as avgQuality, sum(case when e.overall_rating >= 4 then 1 else 0 end) as positiveCount, sum(case when e.overall_rating <= 2 then 1 else 0 end) as negativeCount, sum(case when e.feedback is not null and e.feedback <> '' then 1 else 0 end) as feedbackCount from ai_user_evaluation e where e.create_time is not null and e.create_time >= #{beginTime} and e.create_time < #{endTime}

select e.evaluation_id as evaluationId, e.overall_rating as overallRating, e.feedback as feedback from ai_user_evaluation e where e.create_time >= #{beginTime} and e.create_time < #{endTime} and e.overall_rating <= 2 and e.feedback is not null and e.feedback <> '' order by e.create_time desc limit #{limit}

select count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when t.status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as pendingCount, sum(case when t.status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as completedCount, sum(case when t.status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as overdueCount, sum(case when t.status = '0' and t.priority = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as pendingHighCount from ai_return_visit_task t

select t.task_id as taskId, t.task_no as taskNo, t.caller_name as callerName, t.caller_number as callerNumber, t.priority as priority, t.assignee as assignee, t.assignee_id as assigneeId, t.plan_time as planTime, timestampdiff(MINUTE, t.plan_time, #{now}) as overdueMinutes from ai_return_visit_task t where t.status = '2' and t.plan_time is not null order by t.priority asc, t.plan_time asc limit #{limit}
